sourceSentences: Sona's basic abilities generate a stack of Power Chord, stacking up to 3 times. At 3 stacks, her next basic attack is empowered to consume them all
apply an additional effect based on the last basic ability she cast
Aria of Perseverance - Diminuendo: Reduces the target's size by 8% and damage dealt by 25% for 3 seconds.
Song of Celerity - Tempo: Slows the target by 50% for 2 seconds, capped at 99%.
Gaining Power Chord's empowered attack resets Sona's basic attack timer.
When Power Chord is ready, Sona gains a ring around her. This ring will have a different color depending on the last ability used
Whenever Sona casts a basic ability, her other basic abilities incur a 0.5-second global cooldown

Sona generates a stack of Accelerando each time she hits an enemy champion with Hymn of Valor and each time she mitigates sufficient damage or heals damaged allies with Aria of Perseverance, stacking up to 120 times. At maximum stacks, she instead reduces the current cooldown of Crescendo by 1.5 seconds each time.
Sona sends out bolts of sound to the two nearest visible enemies, prioritizing champions. Each bolt deals magic damage and grants sight of the area around the target for 1 second.
Sona and tagged allied champions deal bonus magic damage on their next attack on-hit within 5 seconds.
If she takes damage during this time, the duration ends prematurely once or if 3 seconds have elapsed.
The projectile of Aria of Perseverance will follow an ally in stealth but will not reveal them.
You can auto attack, press Q, and then auto attack again instantly.
Did you know you can actually get two stacks when you cast a W? The heal is one stack and the second stack is from the shield.
every stack you obtain that would count towards your passive now reduces your ultimate cool down by 1.5 seconds. You can maximize this effect by shielding multiple of your allies on an objective
Sona also makes her allies deal bonus magic damage on their next basic attack within the next five seconds.
When it comes to combos, the main thing is what note you want to end the boosted attack on.
You can treat the W's power attack as a mini- Exhaust. However, finish with Q if you want more damage, or E if you want to slow the target.
